## Survey open-0: LIN-4470 @ ca77a891e

**The map no longer fits the note.** At `ca77a891e`, `## Waiting` in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` holds **22** entries, not 25. Two of the three "move to Runs" items have already gone: the live-wait home and its compare-and-set left with LIN-4459 (`runs-and-dispatch.md:98`), and `COMPLETED` is in no note now. Only the record's `model` is left to move. Pieces 3–5 added entries that none of the ask's buckets name: the `CUT` token order, the per-kind tables, the review tooling-policy wording, constants per kind, and the LIN-4467 witness. Piece 5 has landed, but the Periodical-ceiling entry still says "only a sha256 tripwire". **First:** recount, sort all 22 into the buckets, and post the corrected map on LIN-4448 before touching code.

**The small settlements that aren't:**
- *Cited-path predicate.* The two rules differ. The guard (`tests/unit/area-notes.test.js:26`) accepts a listed set of extensions. `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js:42` accepts any extension of one to six characters, and it checks retirement lines from other repos. The wide rule breaks the guard (`provider.name` becomes a path). The narrow rule refuses another repo's `.ts`, `.py` or `.go` path. You have to choose which behaviour changes, and `citedPaths` has to move out of a test file into `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`.
- *Model lists.* Both hold the same 12 ids in different orders, and both comments call the order a person's choice. The test should check set equality.
- *Five contexts.* `prepareRecommendationInput` already covers the routing entrances. The five renders are a different shape and sit mostly in `routes/proxy-compute.js`. A test over all five is the cheaper retirement.
- *Leaves.* `REGISTRY_PATH` can be derived from `NOTES_DIR` in one line.

**The measurement is where this can fail.** I re-ran the kit's snippet at `ca77a891e`:
- LLM sample: `recommendation-live-wait.js` has left the area (LIN-4459), and `prompts/stage-kinds.js` (43,330 B, piece 3) has entered. That makes 396,063 B against 380,459, with 13 of 14 files paired. Two files are still about half the bytes. Piece 6 itself touches three sampled files (`openrouter.js`, `recommendation-input.js`, `area-registry-path.js`).
- Control moved: `render-task-page.js`, `render-session.js` and `render-proxy.js` have changed since `e8e92d50a` (LIN-4472, LIN-4460, LIN-4471). Kit verdict 4 flags this. LIN-4472 was a structural tidy and may raise the control's Δ, which makes "exceed the control" harder.
- Open PRs: none touches the control's sample. #2446 only edits the `agent-api` and `runs-and-dispatch` notes.
- With two passes and the ±0.5 threshold, a repeat read is likely. Record the bundle-path departure exactly as `area-read-method-as-run.md` did.

**Deeper:** "the entry count falls" measures throughput, not simplicity. Pieces 3–5 added entries through their blind reads about as fast as they settled others, and the `leftover-words.js` entry already predicts this. Report settled entries apart from relocated ones.

**Order:** corrected map, then record the measurement base and the control drift, then the cited-path decision, because it crosses repos.

## Survey global: LIN-4470 @ ca77a891e

**Where it lands.** Mostly `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` (15 KB), plus small leaves: `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`, `lib/prompts/area-registry-path.js`, `lib/call-budget.js`, the two model lists, and `lib/recommendation-input.js` with its callers. The ticket's recount is out of date: **22** entries here (26 @ `4b5001ddf`, 25 @ `5dcf5bcda`). The live-stage wait and its compare-and-set already moved (LIN-4459, `runs-and-dispatch.md:98`). `COMPLETED` isn't in this note. Fewer entries than before, but the survivors get longer with each piece. The `docs/areas` spelling grew to 29 lines in 14 code files (was 26 in 11).

**Done the obvious way:**
- **A move is not an exit.** `docs/areas/README.md:63` allows three: a change settles the entry, a change makes it untrue, or the consequence test sends it to a ticket. Moving entries to Runs (already the biggest note, 24) or A12 lowers this note's count and settles nothing, and the comparison with the control would count that as improvement. **Count settled, moved and kept separately, in the PR and in the measurement.** Guard check 3: the `model` entry cites `lib/model-routing-harnesses.js`, which maps to LLM, so it needs a Runs path first.
- **"Keep, with a reason"** makes entries longer. Waiting has no byte cap (`NOTE_BYTE_CAP` covers Lessons only).
- **Five contexts:** four call sites retype `{ parent, siblings, project, children, comments, attachments }`: `lib/dispatch-entrance.js:1591`, `routes/proxy-compute.js:338`/`:492`, `routes/workspace-api-prompts.js:245`. The fifth is `prepareRecommendationInput`. One `promptContextOf(ctx)` that `prepareRecommendationInput` builds on beats a test over five, which would be a sixth copy.
- **The model lists:** same 12 ids, different order. `catalog-model-facts.test.js` already checks both against the catalog, so "unchecked" is half stale. A set-equality test ties two choices the docstrings call separate. Say in the test why they must match.
- **Two leaves:** there are three copies (`NOT_NOTES` spells `areas.json`). Derive `REGISTRY_PATH` from `NOTES_DIR`. The 29 lines remain, so update the entry, don't retire it.
- **The cited-path rule:** the guard accepts listed extensions only (no `.ts`/`.py`). `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js:42`, the proxy's refusal for every workspace, accepts any 1–6 characters. Moving the guard's `citedPaths` in unchanged would refuse other repos' valid lines. Use the looser rule, or pass the extension list in.
- **`canReason`:** only test callers. Delete it and its asserts in two tests.
- **Lessons:** "retyped in five files" (`:42`) is the Periodical merge rule, not the contexts. Nothing here replaces it.

**Better, and this task can carry it:** the settled/moved/kept tally, one context builder, the derived leaf, `canReason` deleted, the looser predicate. **Not this task's:** the reads feed the count they measure. Close-outs turn blind-read finds into Waiting entries (`525765e55`, `76a52bda6`), so take the measurement before the repeat read's close-out, and say so. A size rule for Waiting, and the prose spelling of `docs/areas`, belong elsewhere.

Agree the cut: keep the Lesson as written, since it is still true

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

## LIN-4470: CI green on PR #2450

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2450, head `ef7ecb735`. CI success (aggregate), Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1 to 4 and Secret scan (source) all passed. The piece is complete as the PR describes. Merge and Done are left to review.

### Leftovers
- tidied: `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`, `docs/architecture/source-map.md` and `tests/unit/lin-4470-note-leaves.test.js` said `NOTES_DIR` and `REGISTRY_FILE` live in `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js` and called that leaf import-free. They are spelled in `lib/prompts/area-registry-path.js` and re-exported.
- tidied: `tests/unit/lin-4467-stage-kind-witness.test.js` and `tests/fixtures/lin-4467-witness.js` still described the tables as hashes. They are text since this PR.
- tidied: the cited-path prose in `docs/areas/README.md` now points to its one predicate (`isCitedPath`), so the rule is not spelled two ways without a link.
- tidied: a stray blank line in the Runs note's Waiting list, before the moved `model` entry.

Retires: `lib/completion-signals.js`: the module is now a view of the stage-kind record but keeps six exports that nothing … calls (Runs & dispatch, the touched area with the most entries). The six exports and their tests are deleted, leaving `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`.

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2450, head `36826cddca83f20e0e6bf33cdb36085436a23eee`. CI is green on that head: CI success, Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan.

## Review — LIN-4470

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2450 at head `36826cddca83f20e0e6bf33cdb36085436a23eee`. Base is `a886fb506`, which is main's tip, and the PR is mergeable.

CI: green on `36826cddc` (run 43580573313, headSha confirmed). Passed: CI success, Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan. I also ran the bearing suites locally on the head (lin-4470-*, area-notes, lin-4467 witness, completion-signals, catalog-model-facts, stream-chat-whole-or-loud, area-map-placement, stage-kind-tables): 170/170 pass.

### Against what was asked, sentence by sentence
- **Recount**: there are 22 entries at `a886fb506`, checked by hand against the old note. Settled 7 + routed 2 + moved 1 + kept 12 = 22. Settled, moved and kept are counted apart, in the PR and in the note's opener.
- **Settle here**:
  - Five contexts: `promptContextOf` (`lib/prompts/prompt-context.js`) is used at all four render sites, and `prepareRecommendationInput` is pinned to carry its fields. No retyped six-field list is left in `lib/` or `routes/`.
  - `canReason`: deleted, and no caller is left.
  - Model lists: a set-equality test, with no new list.
  - Two leaves: `REGISTRY_PATH` is derived from `NOTES_DIR`/`REGISTRY_FILE`, and `NOT_NOTES` uses `REGISTRY_FILE`.
  - Cited-path: one predicate, `isCitedPath`/`citedPaths` in `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`, imported by the guard and by `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js`. Each caller passes its own extension list, so neither caller's behaviour changes. That is a justified departure from the plan, recorded on LIN-4448.
- **Move to Runs**: the wait home and the CAS had already moved (LIN-4459). `COMPLETED` is absent. The `model` entry moved with a Runs citation (`lib/dispatch-factory.js`). Done.
- **Route to LIN-4416**: both finds are posted on LIN-4416 (09:15Z) and removed from the note. Done.
- **Keep, with a reason**: library, outside finds, the reviews archive, the Periodical ceiling, `formatLocalTestRule` and the SD copies are all kept, each with a reason and an owner or blocker. Done.
- **Needs John**: the live-secret case, the size policy and haiku each name John as owner. Done.
- **Rewrite Lessons**: the "five files" Lesson is cut by John's ruling (`lin4470-five-files-lesson`, comment 67451cb6). The table/blind-read Lesson is rewritten for the record. Done.
- **Closing measurement**: both reads are committed at base `49776653d`, with kit blob `cbec2d84` and prompt blob `ef1c2ca9` unchanged. Open PRs were checked: 12 open, none in either sample. Control drift and contamination are recorded. Done.
- **Testing**: area-notes passes, the count falls from 22 to 12, and each settlement has a test.
- **Acceptance**: each entry is settled or says why. Both reads are committed. D = −0.3, so the area does not beat the control, and the PR says so plainly on LIN-4448 (09:18Z). This piece's sentence asks for the result to be *reported*, and it is. Whether **LIN-4448** can close without meeting done-when is a parent-level ruling, like LIN-4447's `lin4447-area-read-inconclusive`. It belongs to LIN-4448's close-out, not to this piece.
- **Retires**: each entry is named one by one in the PR body. The `Retires:` line of the `### Leftovers` comment names the Runs `lib/completion-signals.js` entry, and this diff removes it from `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`. Verified.

### Regression check
`git log` on every touched lib/route file shows no prior fix this re-introduces and no revert this re-applies. Callers of the deleted `completion-signals` exports and `canReason`: none outside the deleted tests (grep across this repo).

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is a hand-built prompt context, or a cited-path rule spelled twice. No instance is left in `lib/` or `routes/`. simple-dispatcher's copies of the leftover rule and guard are the one sibling. They are **outside** this ticket (another repo's owner) and stay in the kept Waiting entry, as the ask directs.

### Mutation checks (each reverted, tree clean)
- M1 drop `attachments` from `promptContextOf`: **red**. `lin-4470-prompt-context` failed, and so did the behaviour tests `proxy-prompt-attachments` (GET /prompt and the recommend-and-dispatch override). This is a real behavioural witness, not only the source scan.
- M2 `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js` `isCitedPath(s, ANY_EXTENSION)` → `isCitedPath(s)` (the guard's narrow list): **stays green** across `dispatch-leftover-answer`, `lin-4414-leftover-answer-route` and `lin-4470-note-leaves`. The PR claims the checker still accepts another repo's bare `main.py`/`index.tsx`, but no test pins that claim: the note-leaves table tests the predicate, not the checker's argument. See ledger item 1.
- M3 drop the `(?::\d+)*` line-suffix allowance: **red** (area-notes and note-leaves).
- M4 reorder CUT's tokens: **red** (closing-contract).
- M5 drop one id from `DISPATCH_MODEL_SUGGESTIONS`: **red** (suggested-model-sets).

### Other findings
- In `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`, the kept `docs/areas/` entry says "spelled in 19 lines across 11 code files (`lib/`, `routes/`, `public/`, `server.js`, `scripts/`), recounted at this base by `grep`". `grep -rc docs/areas lib routes public server.js scripts` at head gives 19 lines in 12 `.js`/`.mjs` files: 17 in 10 under `lib/`, plus `scripts/stability-measures.mjs` and `scripts/code-shape/code-shape-lib.test.mjs`. That rises to 28 lines in 14 files if the `.md` files under `scripts/` count. None are in `routes/`, `public/` or `server.js`. See ledger item 2.
- Commit `36826cddc` edited `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` (7 lines) after the reads at `49776653d`, so the note score is for the note one commit earlier. These are comment and wording corrections only. This is a known limit and does not change D.

### What CI Did Not Prove
1. **Inside.** Claim: "no caller's behaviour changes" for the cited-path rule (bounded class: the cited-path rule, ask bullet 5). The checker's use of `ANY_EXTENSION` is unpinned; mutation M2 stays green. **Before the merge**, close-out adds a test in `tests/unit/dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js` under `describe('the three valid forms')`: `checkLeftoverAnswer` on `answer('Retires: \`main.py\`: the stale handler is deleted')`, or the equivalent body with the heading line, must return `ok: true`, `form: 'entry'` and `path: 'main.py'`. The distinguishing precondition is a bare path with no `/` and an extension outside `NOTE_EXTENSIONS`. Then confirm the test goes red with `isCitedPath(s)` in `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js`, revert, and confirm green.
2. **Inside.** Claim: each kept entry states its facts truly (ask: "each entry that remains names its blocker"). The `docs/areas/` count is misstated. **Before the merge**, close-out changes that entry in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` from "spelled in 19 lines across 11 code files (`lib/`, `routes/`, `public/`, `server.js`, `scripts/`)" to "spelled in 19 lines across 12 code files (`lib/` and `scripts/`, `.js`/`.mjs` only)". The check: `grep -rc docs/areas lib routes public server.js scripts`, counting the non-`.md` files.
3. **Outside** (the parent's question, not this piece's). The repeat reads are LLM reads that CI does not run. Their result, that LIN-4448's done-when is unmet on code, is already reported plainly on LIN-4448 (09:18Z), which this piece's acceptance requires. Discharged for this piece. Whether LIN-4448 closes anyway is John's ruling to raise in LIN-4448's own close-out. Home: LIN-4448.
4. **Outside.** simple-dispatcher's guard and leftover-rule copies still spell their own cited-path rule. The kept Waiting entry (`lib/prompts/leftover-words.js`) records this, with that repo's owner named. Nothing for close-out to do.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. Before merge, close-out makes items 1 and 2, re-runs `node scripts/run-unit-tests.mjs tests/unit/dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js tests/unit/area-notes.test.js`, and re-checks CI on the new head. Items 3 and 4 need no action here.

## Blind read
Verdict: better. It deletes dead API (the six unused helpers in `lib/completion-signals.js` and the test-only `canReason` in `lib/call-budget.js`), turns two copies of the cited-path regex into one predicate (`isCitedPath` in `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`), and replaces four hand-built prompt contexts with `promptContextOf` (`lib/prompts/prompt-context.js`). What it makes worse is small: `lib/recommendation-input.js` still keeps its own hand-typed copy of the field list, guarded by a test instead of derived, and the `PromptContext` typedef in `lib/prompt-templates.js` wasn't updated to match the new projection.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2450 at `36826cddc` against `a886fb506`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `lib/prompt-templates.js` (llm-and-prompts): the `PromptContext` typedef still lists five fields and has no `attachments`. Meanwhile `promptContextOf` in `lib/prompts/prompt-context.js` projects six and writes its own untyped `@returns`. So the shape generatePrompt reads is now described in two places, and they disagree. Fix: add `attachments` to the typedef and point `promptContextOf`'s `@returns` at `PromptContext`.
- `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js` (llm-and-prompts; the test concerns `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`): the test `citedPaths reads repo-relative paths only` (line 163) now exercises the product leaf's `citedPaths`. `tests/unit/lin-4470-note-leaves.test.js` line 90 repeats the same input and the same expected output word for word. Fix: delete one of the two.
- `tests/unit/lin-4470-prompt-context.test.js` (llm-and-prompts; the test concerns `lib/prompts/prompt-context.js`): the header says "the five hand-built recommendation contexts retire into one builder". Only four did. The fifth, `prepareRecommendationInput`, still hand-builds its list, which the file's own third describe and `lib/recommendation-input.js`'s new comment both say. Fix: reword the header to four, plus one that is pinned.

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/recommendation-input.js` (llm-and-prompts): the routing input still spells out the six `promptContextOf` fields by hand. A comment explains it, and a test checks the two lists match after the fact. So one field list now has two owners, kept in step by a test instead of by construction. Folding it into `{ ...promptContextOf(ctx), focusedChild, runs, allRuns }` changes the key order, and the comment says that order has to stay. Deciding whether order matters to the routing prompt or anything that hashes it is a design question, not a fix.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4470

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2450, squash-merged as `fb358dbda` (pinned with `--match-head-commit 69882dc24`, the exact head CI passed on). The deploy landed: harbour.cat's footer shows `fb358dbda`.

**What it does, against what was asked:** review's sentence-by-sentence account stands (comment b008d7b3). The Waiting list went 22 → 12: 7 settled, 2 routed to LIN-4416, 1 moved to Runs & dispatch, 12 kept with a reason and an owner or blocker. Settled, moved and kept are counted apart. Each retirement is named in the PR body. The "retyped in five files" Lesson stays by John's ruling (`lin4470-five-files-lesson`).

**Changes I made after approval** (commit `69882dc24`; nobody re-reviews these):
1. Review ledger item 1: added a test under `the three valid forms` in `tests/unit/dispatch-leftover-answer.test.js`. `checkLeftoverAnswer` on a `Retires:` line citing bare `main.py` returns `ok: true`, `form: 'entry'`, `path: 'main.py'`.
2. Review ledger item 2: the kept `docs/areas/` entry in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` now says 19 lines across 12 code files (`lib/` and `scripts/`, JavaScript only). Rechecked with `grep -rc docs/areas lib routes public server.js scripts`, excluding Markdown: lib 10 files, scripts 2 files, 19 lines. Reworded without backticked `.js`/`.mjs`, because the note guard read those as cited paths (it failed 5 area-notes tests until I did).
3. Blind-read fixes: `attachments` added to `PromptContext` in `lib/prompt-templates.js`. The descriptions were shortened to keep the file under its frozen 19,903-byte ceiling (it is now 19,870). Without that the prompt-size-budget test failed, and I did not raise the ceiling. `promptContextOf`'s `@returns` in `lib/prompts/prompt-context.js` now references that typedef. The duplicated `citedPaths` case was removed from `tests/unit/lin-4470-note-leaves.test.js`, and the prompt-context test header now says four contexts use the builder and the fifth is pinned by a test.

**How each ledger item was settled**
- Item 1 (inside): the new test passes. With `isCitedPath(s, ANY_EXTENSION)` changed to `isCitedPath(s)` it fails (29 pass, 1 fail), and after the revert it passes again (30 of 30).
- Item 2 (inside): fixed as above, with the grep check.
- Item 3 (outside, parent's question): LIN-4448 is already told plainly that D = −0.3 and the area does not beat its control on code. Whether LIN-4448 closes anyway is John's parent-level ruling, so it is not raised here and not repeated.
- Item 4 (outside): simple-dispatcher's guard and leftover-rule copies stay in the kept Waiting entry for `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js`, which names the owner. Nothing to do.
- Blind read: the three fix-sized finds are done (listed above). The larger find, `prepareRecommendationInput` hand-spelling the six `promptContextOf` fields, is inside the area but larger. It changes key order, and whether routing or anything that hashes it cares is a design question. It is already guarded by a test and explained in a code comment. No ticket (inside work is not filed), and no change to the Waiting list, so the 12 count stands.
- Post-deploy: no ledger item needed a live check. I confirmed on main at `fb358dbda` that the new test and the corrected note entry are present and that dispatch-leftover-answer, area-notes and prompt-size-budget pass (58 of 58).

**CI:** green on `69882dc24`, read fresh before the merge: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan and CI success. Locally, the bearing suites passed 147 of 147. Main's post-merge Tests run on `fb358dbda` also succeeded.

**Gate tickets:** none to file. Both outside items are covered by the parent's ruling and the existing note entry. No new related tickets to close: LIN-4416 got the routed finds earlier (09:15Z), and LIN-4448 stays open on its own done-when.

**Archive and prune:** the pre-prune description was captured (snapshot `efd4acbd`, equal to the live description) and the prune follows this comment.

description:
## As asked

Piece 6 of LIN-4448's plan (behaviour **F** and the Done-when measurement). Settle the area's **Waiting entries**, then repeat both area reads. This lands last.

**Approach**

* Recount `## Waiting` in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` at the start. The review verified **25**, not the ask's 26. Each settled entry names its retirement. Each entry that remains names its blocker and owner.
* **Settle here:**
  * the five hand-built recommendation contexts (one builder, or a test over all five);
  * `canReason`, which only tests call;
  * `SUGGESTED_MODEL_IDS` vs `DISPATCH_MODEL_SUGGESTIONS` (a consistency test, no new list; LIN-4358);
  * `docs/areas/` spelled in two leaves (derive one from the other);
  * the cited-path rule (one predicate in `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`, imported by the guard and by `lib/dispatch-leftover-answer.js`).
* **Move to Runs (LIN-4447, agreed):** the live-stage wait's home and its claim compare-and-set, the redeclared `COMPLETED`, and the dispatch record's `model`.
* **Route to A12 / LIN-4416:** the Lesson-authority finding (no content boundary on who adds a Lesson) and the kickoff-goal attribution.
* **Keep, with a reason in the entry:** `lib/library.js` summaries, outside finds gathering in other notes, the `docs/reviews/` archive half, the Periodical prompt ceiling (set after piece 5's re-pin), `formatLocalTestRule` (needs a per-repo test-command setting, which is a product call), and simple-dispatcher's copies of the leftover rule and guard.
* **Needs John, so the entry says so:** the live-secret case (two rules answer it oppositely), the built-in size policy, and the haiku budget (REFUSED stands until a live replay).
* Rewrite the Lessons the new structure replaces: the "retyped in five files" lesson and the table lesson.
* **Closing measurement:** repeat both reads (`llm-and-prompts` and control `front-end-pages`) with the same kit and frozen prompt, at one recorded base. Before reading, check the open PRs against the control's sample again and record any contamination.

**Testing:** `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js` passes, and the entry count falls. Tests for each small settlement above.

**Acceptance:** every Waiting entry is settled or says why not. Both repeat reads are committed. This area's improvement is reported against the control's: **success requires it to exceed the control's**. If it doesn't, say so plainly on LIN-4448.

**Retires:** each settled entry, named one by one in the PR, and the replaced Lessons.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4448 (LLM & prompts, left simpler). The full approved plan is the parent's description, section `## Implementation Plan`, and its amendments are in the parent's comment `### Plan Review Verdict` (72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09). The parent's `## As asked` block sets the scope.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4448's approving plan-review (comment 72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** the plan was written at `JKershaw/LinearViewer` main `2bf788b6d` (surveys at `4b5001ddf`) and reviewed at `c205190fd`. The breakdown re-checked at `5dcf5bcda`. The only change since is LIN-4457 (#2424), and the one plan file it touches is the cost-read entry in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course, and say so in a comment on LIN-4448.

**Every PR names what it retires** (the LIN-4414 rule). It edits the Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` that it settles. It respects that note's Lessons and leaves `docs/reviews/` reports unchanged.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Settles or explains each of the 22 current Waiting entries, reporting settled, moved and kept apart, and takes both repeat reads before close-out adds entries; no Survey finding binds beyond the ask, so the standing policy adds nothing.
**Cuts:**

* the "retyped in five files" lesson: nothing here replaces it, so it stays.
  **Decided by:** a ruling

## Implemented
